scheme_name: Additional Pension to Widow of Ex-Serviceman having Children
other_conditions: Benefit is provided for up to three children of the widow.
Benefit continues until each child dies, reaches age 20, gets married, or becomes employed, whichever occurs first.
The widow must submit a half‑yearly certificate of eligibility (Form III) to the District Sainik Board in June or December.
The widow must inform the District Sainik Board of any change in the status of her children (death, age 20, marriage, or employment).
benefits_summary: Additional monthly pension per child (₹100 for Other Ranks, ₹150 for JCOs, ₹200 for Officers) up to a maximum of ₹300‑₹600, paid quarterly.
